name: @openvoxproject/voxblocks
description: Web components for OpenVox community web sites and apps

scripts.build: vite build && vite build --config vite.cdn.config.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.docs:dev: rm -rf docs/assets docs/_data/manifest.json && concurrently -n vite,jekyll -c blue,magenta "npm:docs:assets:watch" "npm:docs:jekyll:wait"
scripts.docs:jekyll: BUNDLE_GEMFILE=docs/Gemfile bundle exec jekyll serve --livereload --source docs --destination docs/_site
scripts.docs:build: vite build --config docs/vite.config.js && BUNDLE_GEMFILE=docs/Gemfile bundle exec jekyll build --source docs --destination docs/_site --config docs/_config.yml,docs/_config_production.yml
